title: CounselTraj: Synthesizing Process-Aware Psychological Counseling Dialogues via Dialogue-Act Trajectory Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing demand for psychological counseling has motivated the development of LLM-based systems that support human counselors, but training such systems requires large-scale, high-quality dialogue data. Authentic counseling transcripts are difficult to collect and share because of privacy concerns, making synthetic dialogues an important alternative. However, existing synthetic datasets, despite covering diverse scenarios and client profiles, often consist of brief exchanges and fail to capture session-level counseling processes. We propose CounselTraj, a dialogue-act trajectory planning framework for expanding brief synthetic dialogues into process-aware, session-level psychological counseling dialogues. translated_title: CounselTraj：通过对话行为轨迹规划合成过程感知的心理咨询对话
translated_abstract: 日益增长的心理咨询需求推动了基于大语言模型（LLM）的辅助人类咨询师系统的发展，但训练此类系统需要大规模、高质量的对话数据。出于隐私方面的考虑，真实的咨询对话记录难以收集和共享，这使得合成对话成为一种重要的替代方案。然而，现有的合成数据集尽管涵盖了多样的场景和来访者画像，但往往仅包含简短的交流，无法刻画会话层面的咨询过程。我们提出了CounselTraj，这是一个对话行为轨迹规划框架，用于将简短的合成对话扩展为具有过程感知的、会话级别的心理咨询对话。CounselTraj从人类咨询师创作的角色扮演咨询对话中学习对话行为模式，为来访者和咨询师规划协同的轨迹，并将其作为长篇对话生成的灵活引导。
tldr: 提出CounselTraj框架，通过从人类咨询师角色扮演对话中学习对话行为模式并规划来访者与咨询师协同的轨迹，将简短的合成对话扩展为过程感知的会话级心理咨询对话，从而缓解了真实咨询数据因隐私问题难以获取的困境。
en_tdlr: CounselTraj is a dialogue-act trajectory planning framework that expands brief synthetic dialogues into process-aware, session-level psychological counseling dialogues by learning dialogue-act patterns from human counselor role-plays and planning coordinated client-counselor trajectories as flexible guidance for long-form dialogue generation.
